clusters.name: your sister Bea's birth, 1995-1996
clusters.reason: Within about a year and a half of your sister Bea's birth in March 1995, you said Lena was worn out and on edge with the baby, Paul and Lena grew distant with his late nights, you had stomach aches and missed school, Paul and Jonah fell into shouting matches, and Lena did not go back to her job, five shifts falling close together across those months; the later events of 2003 and 2007 sit too far off in time to belong with them.
